public_rationale: The dated credit measurements support the ordinary reading that AI financing conditions had deteriorated compared with preceding weeks. The AI borrowing premium over the broader junk-bond comparison had increased substantially. Several issuers improved during the latest week, so the evidence supports emerging financing stress, not continuous deterioration or a complete funding shutdown.
limitations: The conclusion rests on an independent tracker using disclosed ETF holdings, not a comprehensive official credit index.
The comparison supports the broad observation, not every detail of the quoted commentary.
